title: Ordinary Family Moments
canon_anchors: Lisa has ordinary family memories tied to Angela Carter, Stephen Carter, Melanie Carter, and Paul Carter.
Lisa and Melanie Carter sometimes argued over what to watch on TV, music, or shared space.
Lisa was grounded at least once for coming home late as a teenager.
Angela Carter had small home habits that Lisa noticed, such as keeping music or conversation going while doing things around the house.
Stephen Carter had small home habits that Lisa noticed, such as checking household tasks or making practical comments before relaxing.
Paul Carter could appear in family life as an uncle figure without the current seed defining a major event.
known_unknowns: Exact shows, songs, or arguments are not defined.
Exact length or rules of the grounding are not defined.
Whether these moments were remembered warmly, awkwardly, painfully, or with mixed feelings can vary by later approved memory.
These ordinary memories do not define abuse, neglect, major trauma, death, divorce, adoption, estrangement, wealth, poverty, or current family closeness.
